'''Not a Decipher scan.''' This is the Players Committee's 2007 card-gallery image of [[Gravity Shadow]] at swccgpc.com. It prints the same card text as Decipher's printed card (no errata wording and no bronze disc). Its card area is pixel-identical to Decipher's own scan (the gallery re-hosted Decipher's image). Decipher's own scan is [[:File:Jedi-D-gravityshadow-decipher-archive.gif]], which the card's article and set table now show.

Source: [http://web.archive.org/web/20071204121909id_/http://www.swccgpc.com/cards/PREMIUM/jedi_pack/gravityshadow.gif gravityshadow.gif] in the Players Committee card gallery at swccgpc.com (Internet Archive, 4 December 2007). This wiki file is a flush crop of it (350×490, corner pads bleached white), uploaded 25 September 2026 under the misleading name JediPack-D-gravityshadow-decipher-archive.gif and moved to this name on 12 November 2026 (the old name redirects here).

'''Do not''' replace Holotable [[:File:Jedi-D-gravityshadow.gif]].

Fair use rationale: this is a low-resolution image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. It is used only to identify and discuss the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.
